#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 1000000007;
long long dp[51][51][201][2];
long long ncr[51][51];
int cap, fat, slim;

long long pathfinder(int fatsleft, int slimsleft, int ridesleft, bool boatpos) {
    if (fatsleft == 0 && slimsleft == 0 && ridesleft == 0)
        return 1;
    if (ridesleft == 0)
        return 0;
    if (dp[fatsleft][slimsleft][ridesleft][boatpos ? 0 : 1] != -1)
        return dp[fatsleft][slimsleft][ridesleft][boatpos ? 0 : 1];
    long long ways = 0;
    if (boatpos) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= fatsleft; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= slimsleft; j++) {
                if (i + j > 0 && i * 2 + j <= cap) {
                    ways = (ways + ((ncr[fatsleft][i] * ncr[slimsleft][j]) % MOD * pathfinder(fatsleft - i, slimsleft - j, ridesleft - 1, !boatpos)) % MOD) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
    } else {
        for (int i = 0; i <= fat - fatsleft; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= slim - slimsleft; j++) {
                if (i + j > 0 && i * 2 + j <= cap) {
                    ways = (ways + ((ncr[fat - fatsleft][i] * ncr[slim - slimsleft][j]) % MOD * pathfinder(fatsleft + i, slimsleft + j, ridesleft - 1, !boatpos)) % MOD) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return dp[fatsleft][slimsleft][ridesleft][boatpos ? 0 : 1] = ways;
}

long long powm(long long a, long long b, long long m) {
    long long res = 1;
    a %= m;
    while (b > 0) {
        if (b & 1)
            res = (res * a) % m;
        a = (a * a) % m;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    cin >> cap;
    cap /= 50;
    fat = 0;
    slim = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        if (x == 100)
            fat++;
        else
            slim++;
    }
    
    memset(dp, -1, sizeof(dp));
    memset(ncr, 0, sizeof(ncr));
    ncr[0][0] = 1;
    dp[0][0][0][0] = 1;
    dp[0][0][0][1] = 1;
    
    long long fact[51];
    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 50; i++)
        fact[i] = (fact[i - 1] * i) % MOD;
    for (int i = 0; i <= 50; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
            ncr[i][j] = (fact[i] * ((powm(fact[i - j], MOD - 2, MOD) * powm(fact[j], MOD - 2, MOD)) % MOD)) % MOD;
        }
    }
    
    for (int hola = 1; hola <= 200; hola++) {
        long long res = pathfinder(fat, slim, hola, true);
        if (res != 0) {
            cout << hola << "\n";
            cout << res << "\n";
            return 0;
        }
    }
    cout << -1 << "\n";
    cout << 0 << "\n";
    return 0;
}
